arguments.command:
git commit -qam "chore: release 2.3.0" && git push -q -u origin chore/release-2.3.0 2>&1 | tail -1; gh pr create --base main --head chore/release-2.3.0 --title "chore: release 2.3.0" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Bumps `version` in `package.json` (and `package-lock.json`) to 2.3.0.

## What's new since 2.2.2

- **Working-tree continuity** (#44, closes #33). A thread keeps the files pi leaves uncommitted, staged and unstaged, on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>`, and restores them at the start of the next run. Rewinding or forking the conversation rewinds the files too. New inputs: `worktree_snapshots` (default `true`) and `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Working-tree continuity](docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).

A new feature with no breaking change, so this is a minor release.

## After merging

Per [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md#releases):

```bash
git tag v2.3.0 <merge commit>
git tag -f v2 v2.3.0
git push origin v2.3.0
git push -f origin v2
```

`npm run check` passes on this branch.
EOF
)"
